description: NaLa₉Ge₆O₂₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.51 Å) and three longer (2.68 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent La sites. In the first La site, La is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.91 Å. In the second La site, La is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.91 Å. In the third La site, La is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.96 Å. In the fourth La site, La is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.88 Å. In the fifth La site, La is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.77 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.78 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.79 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three La and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two La and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent La atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent La atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three La and one Ge atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two La, and one Ge atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three La and one Ge atom to form distorted edge-sharing OLa₃Ge tetrahedra. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two La, and one Ge atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three La and one Ge atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three La and one Ge atom.
